inheritance: All discrete-module histories, H2/H3 resolution, display gate, global continuous-colour result, current-climate/topography/soil gates, and the geographic-provenance conclusion are inherited from v4 unless overridden below.

colour.global_species_proxy: Retain the v4 conclusion: the high-depth LAB-lightness signal is a global exact-concept species proxy, not a validated Japan-local radiation history.

jpn38_public_japan_screen.reason: Only one image clears the frozen confidence floor and all three images come from one locality/date/photographer; no threshold was relaxed after observing the result.

jpn29_identity_gate.gate: Inspect PE01523822 determination/annotation history before attaching any Japan-local colour phenotype to this nuclear tip.

colour.status: Japan-local colour history remains blocked. JPN_38 now has a reproducible one-locality licensed-image calibration but not a population proxy; JPN_29 is blocked by specimen/taxon identity rather than colour-image scarcity.

priority_reordering.first: Obtain independent Japan-local C. pendulum evidence beyond the current Fukushima/Aizu series, preferably directly collected or reusable images that can be processed under the same measurement pipeline. Do not promote the one-locality screening value by itself.
priority_reordering.second: Inspect specimen PE01523822 / K. Yonekura 6788 and its determination history to resolve why a Japanese voucher is labelled as C. verutum despite the accepted species range excluding Japan.
priority_reordering.third: Once JPN_38 has population-matched local evidence or another clean fifth Japan-local concept is recovered, rerun the continuous-lightness phylogenetic diagnostic on at least five Japan-local identity-resolved concepts.
priority_reordering.fourth: Only after the Japan-local trait gate passes, resume radiation/rsds, VPD/aridity, wind/sfcWind and improved-soil mechanism screens; then historical climate and biotic interactions.
priority_reordering.discrete_colour: Do not invent a C/W threshold or infer loss/regain from the present continuous image proxy.

claim_boundary: The JPN_38 public-image result is a derived screening calibration from one Japanese locality and cannot substitute for a population-matched trait. JPN_29 has an explicitly Japanese sequenced voucher but an unresolved taxon-concept contradiction; retaining the raw nuclear tip does not authorize a clean Japanese phenotype join.
